build_generic_heat_source: build a generic ion and electron heat source using a Gaussian profile with configurable total power and absorption fraction
calc_generic_heat_source: calculate ion and electron heat source terms from a Gaussian profile given geometry and heating parameters
create_runtime_params: create runtime parameters for a generic heat source with Gaussian location, width, total power, and heat fractions
build_source_config: build a configuration for a generic ion-electron heat source with time-varying Gaussian parameters and default ITER power
run_default_formula: run the default formula to compute ion and electron heat source profiles from runtime parameters and geometry
